name: Distro 10 - (5g) Baller Bucket - MAC
description:
Fresh-frozen flavor, bulk size. The Distro 10 MAC Baller Bucket packs a full 5 grams of live resin — full-spectrum concentrate extracted from fresh-frozen flower to lock in the terpenes and aroma the plant started with. Bold, flavorful, and built for people who go through it.

MAC — short for Miracle Alien Cookies — is a celebrated balanced hybrid born from crossing Alien Cookies with a Colombian and Starfighter cross. Expect a smooth, complex profile: creamy sweetness up front layered with bright citrus, soft floral notes, and a subtly gassy, earthy finish. Because it's live resin, every dab hits with deeper flavor and a fuller, more well-rounded effect — a happy, uplifting lift paired with easy body relaxation that stays balanced start to finish.

Why you'll love it:

5G live resin — bulk value in one bucket, fresh-frozen extraction for maximum terpene preservation
Full-spectrum flavor — rich, aromatic, and true to the strain
Signature MAC flavor — creamy sweetness with citrus, floral, and gassy earth
Bucket packaging — easy to scoop, easy to store, ready to dab

Big flavor, premium potency, and true-to-plant character in every gram. Distro 10 MAC is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Requires a compatible dab rig or vaporizer.
